question.text: Realisation value of officially listed futures or options contracts of a Cat III AIF is determined on the basis of:

answer.text: Latest available settlement prices on the stock exchange where the fund trades
Last traded price of one month ago

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the chapter: 'The realisation value of futures or options contracts officially listed on a market or traded on a regulated market shall be determined on the basis of the latest available settlement prices of these contracts on the stock exchanges and market on which the Fund trades the contracts.' The Trap: Manager models and broker quotes apply to NON-listed OTC derivatives, not exchange-traded. Cross-Exam Context: VIII (Equity Derivatives) tests exchange settlement price. XIX-C echoes it. Manager's Pro-Tip: Use the exchange's official settlement price (DSP) for NAV, not the last-traded price - DSP is volume-weighted over the last 30 minutes on NSE and is the regulator-intended mark.
